label: Fraud-freeze objection — review-result notification standard
unit: business days from a complete application
appliesTo: Notification of a review result, where the application is complete and the evidence adequate. It is not a deadline for releasing the account, and separate restrictions can survive a favourable review.
why: The single most misread number in this area. A supervisory handling standard for answering an objection gets quoted as 'the bank must unfreeze your account in five days', which is a different promise entirely.

history.source: Financial Supervisory Service — standardised handling of objections by account holders not involved in the fraud
history.note: Announced 2026-05-04, implemented first in banking. Not independently confirmed against the primary announcement from this workspace.
